title: Secret agent name
instruction: Make a secret agent code name! Take the first 3 letters of the user's name and the last 3 letters of their favourite food, stick them together, make it CAPITALS, and announce it.
hint: name[:3] means "up to letter 3" and food[-3:] means "the last 3 letters".

blocks.code: food = input("What is your favourite food? ")

expectedOutput: What is your favourite food? pizza
Agent SARZZA, your mission starts now!
